counter_equivalence.scope: Actual combinational counter implementation extracted verbatim from cpu_core.sv, compared with independent modular accepted-minus-sent arithmetic for every input value.

scope: Qualification for the changed MDU, preselected Store word-match bitmap, validity-masked forwarding data and precomputed memory-queue send count. Full official 19-case correctness, 6-case performance, 189 strict default directed/random runs, 6 per-commit performance runs, 945 compatibility runs, 27 fault runs, 12 writeback-fault runs, 2 combinational-loop checks, MDU arithmetic/latency/cancellation tests in Icarus and Verilator, 7 forwarding equivalence proofs, 5 modular counter equivalence proofs on the verbatim production fragment, and full-chip synthesis/STA passed. Unchanged MDU-only tests and same-source screening results are reused with source checks; all other final tests use the frozen current source. Baseline memory-unit, other execution/frontend units and unrelated formal checks were not rerun. Speed is measured in the local course Linux ARM64 container, not on the OJ host. Timing is the unchanged ideal-clock/no-parasitics course estimate.
